description: From the Atlanta Journal-Constitution Here are the details for voting absentee in Georgia. The U.S. Supreme Court on Monday rejected the efforts by President Donald Trump’s administration to put new restrictions on voting by mail in this year’s midterms. The administration sought to require states to adopt a special, uniform envelope style for absentee ballots […]
